en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Khalid, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Abu Nasr, 
(It has been narrated) from Al-Reza<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The carnelian negates the poverty, and wearing the carnelian negates the hypocrisy’.
en.sarwar: 1. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn abu Nasr who has said the following: “Al-Rida’, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Carnelian disallows poverty and wearing carnelian dispels hypocrisy.’”
